caption: The drawing depicts a jug or pitcher with a large, ornate handle on the left and a wide spout on the right. The jug is rendered in shades of gray with transparent qualities, suggesting it is made of glass or a similar material. Decorative elements in a muted blue color are distributed across its surface, including floral or cloud-like clusters near the top and on the sides. On the main body of the jug, there are two blue figurative reliefs: one on the left shows a robed or draped figure standing and facing a pedestal or altar, and the one on the right features a winged male figure holding a sickle or scythe, standing next to a seated or crouched smaller figure. The jug has a wide, rounded belly, a narrow neck, and a stable, circular foot. The background is plain and beige, and the drawing shows careful shading and contours to portray the reflective and three-dimensional qualities of the jug.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
